answer: Naive design pays per address. This one rotates the session key only when a task closes and converts the reward into a slow vesting stream. Numbers: 1,000 addresses at 1 bond each buy nothing against 1,000 closed tasks at 1 bond each, because that path needs 1,000 real jobs before a coin vests. A raven can repeat a name, not a receipt hash, and a duplicate leaves a sable mark on both accounts. The cost tracks the tide of work, not headcount.
